subject: Hiring stack: coordinating Greenhouse + Checkr + Learnio contracts
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Greenhouse Sales <sales@greenhouse.io>, Checkr, Inc. (Ops) <ops@checkr.com>, Learnio LMS Renewals <renewals@learnio.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Hiring stack renewal coordination – Greenhouse / Checkr / Learnio

Hi all,

Following up from our renewal calendar, Redwood's contracts for Greenhouse (ATS), Checkr (background checks) and Learnio (LMS) all come due in the next 60–90 days. We'd like to coordinate timing and commercial terms so Procurement and Legal can approve a consolidated plan instead of handling three stove-piped renewals.

Attached: Greenhouse_SOW_2026_v2.pdf (current draft), Checkr_PO_Template.docx, Learnio_Renewal_Quote.pdf.

Asks/goal for this thread:
- Can each vendor confirm whether pricing/seat counts are locked for a 60-day renewal window?
- Greenhouse: can we get a single invoice for hosted seats + add-ons (single billing entity)?
- Checkr: confirm per-screen pricing hold and whether we can get a firmed Quote + PO template back for Legal.
- Learnio: confirm license tiers and whether we can move to annual consolidation under one invoice.

Proposed timeline: collect redlines/pricing by Fri 20 Mar -> internal review next week -> finalize SOW/POs + DocuSign by end of March.

I'll coordinate a 30-minute sync if helpful — proposing Wed 17 Mar 11:00 PT if vendors are available.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Fisher <sales@greenhouse.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 12:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Hiring stack renewal coordination – Greenhouse / Checkr / Learnio

Hi Marissa — thanks for the note and the attachments. We're happy to align. Quick answers:
- Pricing: we can hold current seat pricing for 60 days from today if Redwood can confirm expected seat count by 20 Mar.
- Billing: we can consolidate to a single invoice if billing entity remains the same (we'll need the billing address/PO number).
- Attachments: attached updated SOW (Greenhouse_SOW_2026_v2.pdf) with a one-line change to seat counts.

Couple items we’ll need from you: current seat rollover number (or delta), and whether you want the Advanced Reporting add-on to remain. If Legal has redlines, send them and we'll run through our commercial team.

We can attend Wed 17 Mar 11:00 PT — Jordan Fisher (Enterprise Renewals).

Regards,
Jordan Fisher
Enterprise Renewals
Greenhouse

Attachment: Greenhouse_SOW_2026_v2.pdf (PDF)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Hiring stack renewal coordination – internal legal review notes

Marissa — quick internal legal notes before we hand anything back to the vendors:
- Data residency: Greenhouse SOW needs explicit language about EU/US data segmentation for candidate PII. If Greenhouse cannot commit, we need a compensating control or SOC2 evidence.
- Indemnity & liability caps: vendor language is standard; request a mutual cap aligned with Redwood's playbook.
- PO/Payment terms: recommend 30 days net for Checkr; any longer and we need early termination protection for Redwood.

I'll prepare a redline for the Greenhouse SOW and upload to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HiringStackRenewals (see file: GHouse_SOW_redline_2026.docx). Please share any vendor contractual exceptions you expect.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shah <ops@checkr.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 15:40:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Hiring stack renewal coordination – Checkr pricing and PO

Hi Marissa — thanks for including Checkr. We can hold per-screen pricing at current levels for renewals signed by 31 Mar. Attached is our PO template (Checkr_PO_Template.docx). A couple requests:
- Headcount forecast for next 12 months (screens/month) so we can confirm volume tiers.
- Preferred billing cadence (monthly vs. annual) — we can do either; annual gives a 6% discount.

If helpful, we can join the 17 Mar sync.

Best,
Priya Shah
Account Operations
Checkr, Inc.

Attachment: Checkr_PO_Template.docx (DOCX)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Greenhouse Sales <sales@greenhouse.io>, Priya Shah <ops@checkr.com>, Learnio LMS Renewals <renewals@learnio.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 16:35:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Hiring stack renewal coordination – next steps and meeting

Thanks all — summary and next steps:
- Vendors confirmed holds: Greenhouse (60 days), Checkr (pricing hold through 31 Mar), Learnio requested confirmation by 20 Mar.
- Legal will send redline for Greenhouse SOW (Laura) by EOD 13 Mar.
- Procurement (Neha) will assemble headcount forecast and preferred billing entity by 18 Mar.
- Action: vendors to return final quotes/SOWs with any commercial notes by 20 Mar so we can route for approval.

I've attached a one-page consolidated timeline for approvals and the proposed 17 Mar 11:00 PT sync invite (consolidated_timeline_2026.xlsx). Please confirm availability for the meeting — will send a calendar invite once confirmed.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: consolidated_timeline_2026.xlsx, Learnio_Renewal_Quote.pdf
